decisions.reason: Because the aloe vera facial care line is very close to the firm's core skincare knowledge and remained prominently presented on its own page across both years, management would see enough fit and learning potential to continue it.

The hyaluronic acid serum also builds directly on the firm's existing formulation and facial-care capabilities, and its continued presence on the website suggests results were sufficient to justify further refinement rather than withdrawal.

Although facial cleansing milk is close to the firm's established knowledge base, its disappearance from the website by 2024 indicates weak market traction or limited strategic value, so resources would be better reallocated.

As a newly launched cleansing oil in 2024 that is closely related to the firm's established skincare range, it fits the firm's absorptive capacity well and should be kept to allow more time for market learning and improvement.
